An correspondent bank that has behavior that deviates substantially from its peer group may be suspicious and warrant additional investigation. This scenario identifies correspondent banks that deviate from their peer groups in debit activity, credit activity or both.

from @MINER@.CLIENT_BANK_PEER_GRP cp inner join @MINER@.CLIENT_BANK_SMRY_MNTH csm on csm.INSTN_SEQ_ID = cp.INSTN_SEQ_ID inner join @MINER@.CB_PEER_TRXN_SMRY_MNTH cpsm on cp.PEER_GRP_INTRL_ID = cpsm.CB_PEER_GRP_INTRL_ID inner join @MINER@.ACCT_ID_INSTN_ID_MAP an on cp.INSTN_SEQ_ID = an.INSTN_SEQ_ID inner join @MINER@.ACCT a on an.ACCT_INTRL_ID = a.ACCT_INTRL_ID where -- ------ get account transactions amonut for lookback period --------------------------------------------- csm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT <= (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED2' and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and csm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT >= (select add_months(f_trunc_date(k.CLNDR_DT, 'MM'), -@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1' and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') -- ------ get peer group transactions amonut for lookback period --------------------------------------------- and cpsm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT <= (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED2' and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and cpsm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT >= (select add_months(f_trunc_date(k.CLNDR_DT, 'MM'), -@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1' and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and csm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT = cpsm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT group by cp.INSTN_SEQ_ID, cp.PEER_GRP_INTRL_ID, csm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT having min(a.ACCT_OPEN_DT) <= (select add_days(k.CLNDR_DT, -@Open_Days) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') ) t group by t.INSTN_SEQ_ID, t.PEER_GRP_INTRL_ID
